scripts.test: npm run build:core && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test packages/core/src/*.test.ts apps/workers/search/src/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:core && node --import tsx --test packages/core/src/ai-provider.test.ts packages/core/src/commands.test.ts packages/core/src/file-storage.test.ts packages/core/src/inference.test.ts packages/core/src/profile.test.ts apps/workers/search/src/collect.test.ts apps/web/src/lib/api.test.ts
scripts.test:queue-runtime: npm run build:core && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test scripts/check-queue-runtime.ts
scripts.test:database-recovery: npm run build:core && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test scripts/check-database-recovery.ts
scripts.test:backfill-job-sightings: npm run build:core && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test scripts/backfill-job-sightings.test.ts
scripts.test:crash-recovery: npm run build:core && node --env-file=.env --import tsx scripts/check-crash-recovery.ts
scripts.test:performance: npm run build:core && node --env-file=.env --import tsx scripts/check-performance.ts
scripts.test:soak: npm run build:core && node --env-file=.env --import tsx scripts/check-soak.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --force && npm exec --workspace @careerscope/web -- next typegen && tsc --noEmit --project apps/web/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -b && npm run build --workspace @careerscope/web
scripts.lint: eslint packages apps/api apps/workers scripts drizzle.config.ts eslint.config.mjs && npm run lint --workspace @careerscope/web
scripts.services:queue: docker compose --env-file .env -f compose.yml --profile bullmq up -d --wait --no-deps redis-queue
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n api,publisher,worker,files,web "npm run start:api" "npm run start:publisher" "npm run start:worker" "npm run start:files" "npm run start:web"
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:core && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test packages/core/src/bull-queue.test.ts packages/core/src/database.test.ts packages/core/src/market.test.ts packages/core/src/queue.test.ts packages/core/src/resumes.test.ts packages/core/src/runtime.test.ts scripts/run-scheduled-discovery.test.ts scripts/check-lead-liveness.test.ts scripts/enforce-search-retention.test.ts
